messages:
Sam Patel: heads up — alerts just fired for high error rate on streaming/paging endpoints (prod). dashboards show spike starting ~5m ago. stacktrace points to client->server streaming frame parse failures. tagging oncall.
incident-bot: [ALERT] prod: streaming.paging.errors > 5% for 3m across region-us-west. Incident severity: P1. Pager duty: Maya Chen. Link: https://ops.example/redwood/alerts/2381
Maya Chen: digging. canary was rolled out ~10m before spike (sdk v3.2). suspected header/serialization change between v3.1 -> v3.2. pulling canary logs.
Jonah Reed: seeing repeated: `ERR: CursorDeserializeError: unexpected field \"next_cursor\"` from server side when handling client frames. only from connections advertising `sdk_version: 3.2`.
Olivia Park: confirmed — streaming proxy returns 503 for ~10% of connections carrying `x-sdk-origin: v3.2`. non-streaming endpoints stable.
Sam Patel: assign kill-switch for feature flag `sdk_v3_streaming` and pause rollout. Maya, can you flip? :rotating_light:
Maya Chen: flipping now. `curl -X POST https://flags.internal/kill/sdk_v3_streaming -d '{"enabled":false}'`
Maya Chen: done — flag off. canary traffic reduced to 0 in 30s. metrics: errors dropping.
Liz Ramos: starting emergency rollback for the canary release to v3.1-tag-2026-03-15. prepping helm rollback command.
Jonah Reed: past logs show malformed paging cursor shape changed shape in v3.2: old proto field `cursor_v1` -> `cursor_payload`. Server deserializer not tolerant. quick patch would be to accept both fields but that may take >30m. rollback is faster.
Maya Chen: initiating rollback: ```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/sdk-canary --to-revision=2026-03-15-v3.1
```
incident-bot: Deploy rollback started. Link: https://ci.example/jobs/rollback-5821. Notifying watchers.
Sam Patel: customer impact assessment: ~2.3% of total token throughput affected by streaming faults during window. 4 enterprise customers saw increased timeouts (ACME, FinVault, EduLeap, OmniRetail). Preparing CS notes.
CS-Bot: Created ticket CS-9921 for ACME Inc. Assigned to Liz Ramos.
Olivia Park: posting preliminary customer guidance: "If you rely on streaming/paging, please pin SDK to v3.1 while we investigate. We are rolling back the v3.2 rollout and will follow up with postmortem." Will send via customer escalation channel.
Liz Ramos: rollback confirmed complete. `kubectl get pods` shows canary instances replaced, ready count at 100%. Metrics back to baseline for streaming errors.
Jonah Reed: after rollback, still seeing a handful of `CursorDeserializeError` from long-lived connections — likely stale clients that didn't reconnect. we'll rate-limit and return graceful 429s for those. patch queued.
Maya Chen: handing off to night oncall @Olivia for 2-8am PT monitoring. will write runbook steps and evidence.
Olivia Park: I have the kill-switch in place and rollback in prod. monitoring alert thresholds set to lower (2%). I'll keep watch and escalate if >1% re-occurrence.
Sam Patel: summary for follow-up: root cause suspected client-side SDK v3.2 header/proto shape change that the server runtime didn't accept. Immediate mitigation: feature-flag kill + rollback to v3.1. Customer impact: transient streaming failures for a subset of clients; active cases created. Next steps: short postmortem, compatibility test added to CI matrix, server tolerant parsing patch.
Liz Ramos: adding postmortem owners: Maya (incident lead), Jonah (root cause & patch), Olivia (monitoring & followup), Sam (customer comms).
incident-bot: Incident P1 -> set status: mitigated. Follow-up tasks: postmortem due in 72h.
Sam Patel: thanks team. will draft a short customer-facing note and add timeline. if anyone has logs or repros, drop into #eng-runtime with label `incident-3521234567`. :thumbsup:
Olivia Park: noted — I'll include repro from one ACME trace. signing off the thread for handoff — will update morning status.
